meta.title: Invite Us — Misbah EDU
meta.description: Misbah EDU: lectures, the Misbah Choir and youth gatherings. Choose a program and invite us to your jamaat, school or community.

invite.title: Bring Misbah to your community
invite.text: Write to us with the date, place and type of program, and we will agree on the details together.

hero.tag: Invite Us · Youth initiative · Sarajevo · since 2022
hero.title: The light of knowledge, live in your community
hero.text: Young hafizes, imams and lecturers. Choose what you would like to host, and we will come to your jamaat, school or event.

gatherings.title: Join us
gatherings.text: What does Misbah offer to young people?

lectures.title: Educational lectures
lectures.description: We open important topics of faith and everyday life, bringing Islamic values closer to young people in a modern way that is close to them.

workshops.title: Interactive workshops
workshops.description: Through creative tasks, conversation and teamwork, we encourage active participation, the exchange of ideas and the development of new skills.

quizzes.title: Knowledge quizzes
quizzes.description: Through fun, team competition and socializing, we encourage young people to broaden their knowledge of Islam, Islamic history and general culture.

visednevna.description: An intensive program over a weekend or several days.

hamdo.bio: Teaching associate for qira'at at the Faculty of Islamic Studies and a doctoral student. Leads the tafsir halaqa on Thursdays in the Carina jamaat.

hamza.bio: The life of the Prophet ﷺ and lessons for today. Leads the seerah halaqa on Mondays after Maghrib in the Bjelave jamaat.

mubina.bio: Assistant at the Department of Shariah Law (Fiqh) at the Faculty of Islamic Studies and hafiza of the Qur'an. Speaks about worship, family and the questions faced by the contemporary Muslim woman.
topics: The character of the Prophet ﷺ
